tasks.title: Setup Project Repository and Initial Configuration
tasks.description: Initialize the project repository, install dependencies, and configure environment variables.
tasks.details: Clone the repository, install Node.js 18.0.0 or higher, and run `npm install`. Create a `.env` file with ANYLIST_EMAIL, ANYLIST_PASSWORD, and ANYLIST_CREDENTIALS_FILE. Add `.env` and `.anylist_credentials` to `.gitignore`. Use TypeScript for type safety and FastMCP for MCP server implementation. Recommended libraries: Node.js 18+, TypeScript 5.x, FastMCP (latest), tsx for running TypeScript.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify repository setup, dependency installation, and environment variable configuration by running `npm run type-check` and checking for errors. Ensure `.env` and `.anylist_credentials` are not tracked by git.

tasks.title: Implement AnyList API Service Layer
tasks.description: Create a service layer to interact with the AnyList API using provided credentials.
tasks.details: Implement `anylist-service.ts` to handle authentication, list, recipe, and meal planning operations. Use the unofficial AnyList API wrapper (anylist-api) for Node.js. Handle session management, error handling, and retries. Store credentials securely and refresh tokens as needed. Use axios or node-fetch for HTTP requests.
tasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests for authentication, list retrieval, and basic CRUD operations. Mock API responses to test error handling and edge cases.

tasks.title: Define MCP Tool Types and Schemas
tasks.description: Define TypeScript types and validation schemas for MCP tools.
tasks.details: Create `types/index.ts` for shared types (List, Item, Recipe, MealEvent). Use Zod for runtime validation in `utils/validation.ts`. Define schemas for all tool parameters and responses.
tasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests for type definitions and validation schemas. Ensure all required fields are validated and error messages are clear.

tasks.title: Implement List Management Tools
tasks.description: Implement MCP tools for list management: get, add, update, remove, toggle, and bulk operations.
tasks.details: Create `tools/list-tools.ts` with functions for each list operation. Use the AnyList service to interact with the API. Implement error handling and input validation using Zod. Expose tools via FastMCP.
tasks.testStrategy: Write integration tests for each list tool. Test with valid and invalid inputs, and verify API responses and error handling.

tasks.title: Implement Recipe Management Tools
tasks.description: Implement MCP tools for recipe CRUD, details, import, collections, and search.
tasks.details: Create `tools/recipe-tools.ts` with functions for recipe operations. Use the AnyList service for API calls. Support recipe import from URLs where possible. Implement validation and error handling.
tasks.testStrategy: Write integration tests for each recipe tool. Test recipe creation, update, deletion, import, and search. Verify error handling and edge cases.

tasks.title: Implement Meal Planning Tools
tasks.description: Implement MCP tools for meal event management, recipe assignment, and calendar integration.
tasks.details: Create `tools/meal-tools.ts` with functions for meal event CRUD, recipe assignment, and calendar views. Use the AnyList service for API calls. Implement validation and error handling.
tasks.testStrategy: Write integration tests for each meal tool. Test meal event creation, update, deletion, recipe assignment, and calendar views. Verify error handling and edge cases.

tasks.title: Integrate MCP Server with Claude Desktop
tasks.description: Configure and test integration with Claude Desktop or other MCP-compatible clients.
tasks.details: Update Claude Desktop configuration to point to the MCP server. Use environment variables for credentials. Ensure the server starts and exposes all tools. Test natural language interactions.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify server starts and exposes all tools. Test natural language commands in Claude Desktop. Check for authentication and connection issues.

tasks.title: Implement Debug and Logging Features
tasks.description: Add debug logging and error reporting for troubleshooting.
tasks.details: Use the `debug` library for verbose logging. Set `DEBUG=anylist-mcp` to enable. Log API requests, responses, and errors. Add error reporting for common issues.
tasks.testStrategy: Enable debug mode and verify logs are generated for API calls and errors. Test error reporting for authentication and connection issues.

tasks.title: Write Comprehensive Unit and Integration Tests
tasks.description: Develop a robust test suite covering all tools and edge cases.
tasks.details: Use Jest for unit and integration tests. Mock AnyList API responses. Test all tool functions, validation, and error handling. Include test coverage reporting.
tasks.testStrategy: Run `npm test` and `npm run test:coverage`. Ensure all tools and edge cases are covered. Aim for high test coverage.

tasks.title: Document API Reference and Usage Examples
tasks.description: Create detailed documentation for all MCP tools and usage examples.
tasks.details: Document each tool’s parameters, responses, and usage in the README. Include natural language examples for Claude Desktop. Add troubleshooting and common issues sections.
tasks.testStrategy: Review documentation for accuracy and completeness. Test example commands in Claude Desktop. Verify troubleshooting steps.

tasks.title: Project Setup and Dependencies
tasks.description: Initialize project structure, install core dependencies, and configure development environment
tasks.details:
1. Initialize Node.js project with TypeScript
2. Install dependencies:
   - fastmcp@latest for MCP implementation
   - anylist@latest for API integration
   - dotenv@^16.3.1 for environment management
   - zod@^3.22.4 for validation
   - tsx@^4.7.0 for TypeScript execution
   - jest@^29.7.0 for testing
3. Configure TypeScript (tsconfig.json)
4. Setup ESLint and Prettier
5. Create project structure as specified in PRD
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Verify all dependencies install correctly
2. Run typescript compilation check
3. Validate ESLint configuration
4. Test environment variable loading
